text: CODEMART :: Company Hardest part of computer science: naming things When Codemart was founded in 2004, nobody had Cluj on the radar for software development. | Near-shoring was largely unheard of. | But a few highly experienced Romanian mavens partnered with German incubators to change that. | This commitment to high quality has been put in writing with our Company Policy for Quality and proven by our ISO 9001 certification for developing client-oriented software , issued by TUV Austria. | At CODEMART, we believe that gender equality is both a moral imperative and a business advantage. | A diverse and inclusive workforce enhances innovation, strengthens collaboration, and ensures that our products and services reflect the needs of all users. | The final frontier: software for neuroscience Arguably one of the most complex applications a client could order: a simulator for the human brain . | But that's exactly what Codemart has been doing since 2010 – with great success! | Creating innovative neuroscience applications is a cornerstone of Codemart's work. | Since 2011, Codemart team members are regularly participating in major international neuroscience conferences and exhibitions like SfN and OCNS . | Since 2014, Codemart has been an official mentor for the Google Summer of Code and has been invited to the prestigious annual Google Mentors Meeting several times. | Codemart team members are contributing to many groundbreaking scientific papers in computational neuroscience. | On a large scale: software for business Codemart was founded as a highly specialized Java boutique since this allowed to reach a wide range of scalable applications and platforms for clients in many industries. | Although Java is still its core specialty, Codemart has been picking up many other languages and frameworks as client needs evolved, e.g. | .NET, Kotlin, JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
